m: प्रांशु mfn. (said to be fr. प्र + अंशु) high, tall, long, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्रांशु m. N. of a son of Manu Vaivasvata, Hariv.; Pur.
of a son of Vatsa-prī (or -prīti), Pur.
a: प्रांशु — a. [प्रकृष्टाः अंशवोऽत्र] 1 High, tall, lofty, of lofty or great stature (as a man); शालप्रांशुर्महाभुजः R. 1. 13; 15. 19. --2 Long, extended; Ś. 2. 15. --शुः A tall man, a man of great stature; प्रांशुलभ्ये फले मोहादुद्बाहुरिव वामनः R. 1. 3.

m: प्रांशुक mfn. large, big (said of an animal), HYog.
प्रांशु—लभ्य mfn. to be obtained or reached (only) by a tall person, Ragh.
प्रांशु—प्राकार mfn. having long walls, Kathās.

a: प्रांगं — A small kind of drum ( पणव).
प्रांगणं(नं) — 1 A court, courtyard. --2 A floor (as of the house). --3 A kind of drum.
प्रांजल — a. 1 Straightforward, candid, honest, sincere. --2 Straight, erect.
प्रांजलि — a. [प्रसृतौ अंजली येन] Folding the hands in supplication, as a mark of respect or humility.

प्रांतः — [प्रकृष्टोंऽतः] 1 Edge, margin, border, skirt, verge; प्रांतसंस्तीर्णदर्भाः Ś. 4. 7. --2 Corner (as of the lips, eyes &c.); Māl. 4. 2; ओष्ठ˚, नयन˚. --3 Boundary, extremity. --4 Extreme verge, end; यौवनप्रांत Pt. 4. --5 A point, tip. --6 The back part. --Comp. A --ग a. living close by. --दुर्गं a suburb outside the walls of a town, a town near a fort. --विरस a. tasteless in the end. --शून्य a. see प्रांतरशून्य. --स्थ a. one who inhabits the borders.

प्रांतरं — [प्रकृष्टमंतंर यत्र] 1 A long, lonesome or solitary path, desolate road. --2 A road without shade, dreary tract of land. --3 A forest, wilderness. --4 The hollow of a tree. --Comp. --शून्यः a long dreary road (without trees, shade &c.).
प्रांततः — ind. Marginally, along the border or edge.
